study type: longitudinal, observational, prospective, descriptive, and analytical study
cohort: 450 pregnant women with PAPP-A <0.4 MoM at Hospital Clinico San Carlos between January 2009 and December 2015
finding: Adverse events were very frequent in patients with low levels of PAPP-A (70%).
mod_finding: The route of delivery was 70% vaginal and 30% cesarean.
